items.title: Al Chez interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, February 13, 2019
items.q: Al was interviewed in New Hartford, NY on February 13, 2019 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Al was interviewed in New Hartford, NY on February 13, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
Okay. My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive with Al Chez here in New Hartford High School band room. Thanks for driving all this way.
Thank you. My pleasure. I love coming out to the schools and giving back to the different communities.
